description: Use this to see which countries and kinds of price the tools cover. It returns a short overview: for each tool the countries it answers for, how many official sources stand behind it and how often they update. Give category and/or country to get the full detail of the matching sources instead (publisher, licence, attribution line, limits, example requests). Every source at once, as JSON: https://proofprice.com/api/v1/coverage

category.description: Optional. Return the full detail of this category's sources: one of border-prices, broadband, cars, childcare, commercial-property, construction, contracts, diet-costs, energy, farm-gate-prices, farm-prices, flights, fuel, groceries, health-insurance, home-sales, home-upgrades, hotels, insurance, land-prices, medical, medicines, price-levels, producer-prices, rent, state-property-rents, supplementary-health-insurance, surplus-auctions, transport-fares, tuition, wholesale-fresh-food, wholesale-markets, wholesale-power (the tool name also works).

country.description: Optional. Return the full detail of the sources that cover this country: an ISO code such as IE, GB or FR. Can be combined with category.

name: pricepaid_coverage

outputSchema.description: Tools, countries and official sources covered; full per-source detail for a category and/or country.

title: What price data is covered
